name: Can I add a second story bathroom during a home addition?

mainEntity.name: Can I add a second story bathroom during a home addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, adding a second-story bathroom during a home addition is feasible but requires careful planning for water supply, drainage, and waste lines. It often involves extending existing stacks or installing new ones to connect to the main sewer line. Proper structural support for the new plumbing and fixtures, as well as adequate water pressure, are critical considerations for a successful installation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, adding a second-story bathroom is possible but requires careful planning for water, drainage, and structural support.
